messages:
elaine: quick callout  can we avoid a transient toast for secret downloads? thinking a persistent anchor in the create panel is friendlier for keyboard and screen reader users.

 tom: +1. toasts disappear and keyboard users miss them. if we keep it in-panel we can show a 30s countdown explicitly: 'Download available for 30s'.

 maria: backend ok with one-time URL with TTL. API: POST /api-keys {name, reveal:false} -> {id, oneTimeUrl, expiresAt}. we'll surface expiresAt in the UI to drive the countdown.

 nick: a11y notes: announce reveal and expiry via aria-live regions. countdown must not be read every second (use polite updates at 30/15/5s). ensure link is focusable and has descriptive text.

 tom: microcopy proposal: primary CTA 'Create and reveal', secondary 'Create (no reveal)'. inline helper: 'Shown once 8  copy now or download the keyfile.'

 elaine: for rotate flow let's show an inline checklist: '1. create replacement 2. swap clients 3. revoke old' with clear CTA at each step. keyboard-focusable checkboxes.

 maria: responsive: panel on desktop, fallback modal on small screens. will prototype keyboard-first behavior.

 deploy-bot: design mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/download-anchor-panel ":rocket:"
